newsitem.title: USA: U.S. blue chips push to fresh session highs.
newsitem.headline: U.S. blue chips push to fresh session highs.

text.p: U.S. blue chips pushed to fresh session highs in late trading on Tuesday in a broad rally following favorable econommic data.
The Dow was up 132 points, or two percent, at 6916. Gainers held a lead of almost four-to-one over decliners.
The Dow pushed through the 6900 mark, which some technical analysts pointed to as key near-term resistance.
Traders also cited the move by the long-bond below the seven percent yield mark as a bullish sign. The 30-year Treasury bond was up 1-16/32 to yield 6.99 percent.
